arguments.sql: SELECT c.card_type AS card_type, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id GROUP BY c.card_type ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, c.card_type
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions grouped by card type, from the largest count down.
assumptions: Counts every transaction, labelled or not, since this is a volume question rather than a fraud rate.
Card type is taken from the card each transaction was made on (transactions.card_id -> cards.id).
'Debit' and 'Debit (Prepaid)' are reported as separate card types.
Transactions whose card_id has no matching card are left out.
